candidates.raw_title: Altruist Biologics Launches Altru-CON High-Concentration Formulation Platform
candidates.gate_e: A previously untracked competitor platform claiming up to 200 mg/mL with >2x viscosity reduction -- a direct rival to the CDMO high-concentration platforms S-HiCon and WuXiHigh 2.0 already benchmarked here.

candidates.raw_title: 휴온스랩, 하이디퓨즈 적용 ADC 피하주사 조성물 특허 등록
candidates.gate_e: Extends a tracked Korean rHuPH20 platform from mAbs into ADCs with quantified nonclinical absorption gains -- more antibody payload delivered subcutaneously.

candidates.raw_title: DARZALEX FASPRO-based quadruplet regimen approved in the U.S. for transplant-ineligible NDMM
candidates.gate_e: Label expansion moving an ENHANZE-enabled SC product into frontline use in its largest indication, widening the SC-converted treated population.

candidates.raw_title: FDA approves atezolizumab for adjuvant treatment of muscle invasive bladder cancer with molecular residual disease
candidates.gate_e: Label expansion on an ENHANZE marketed product that puts ENHANZE and ALT-B4 head-to-head in the same indication (cf. the 2026-09-18 Keytruda SC CHMP MIBC opinion).

candidates.raw_title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07646548 -- PK/tolerability of SC dupilumab coformulated with berahyaluronidase alfa
candidates.gate_e: Primary registry record for the Dupixent x ALT-B4 Phase 1 already tracked from trade press -- the benchmark product's own concentration-enabling reformulation.

candidates.raw_title: Qprotyn HILOPRO viscosity-reduction platform (>250 mg/mL, <20 cP, two GRAS excipients)

candidates.reject_reason: Gate B: platform exists but no discrete dated event (no patent grant, partnership, filing or publication with a confirmable date) could be located. Carry forward as a watch item.

candidates.gate_e: Already-tracked technology; capability marketing, not an event.
